dict.string: 15-min cache-write walker for /cold-storage. Fetches balances for every category=ripple address in named_accounts.json via LAN rippled (XRPL_LOCAL_NODE) and upserts them into cold_storage_snapshot in Neon. The /cold-storage route reads from the table instead of making 21 live account_info RPCs per page render. Wired 2026-09-03 to kill ~214/hr walker_node_fallback rows against public Ripple servers. StartInterval per macos_startinterval_over_calendar rule (rolling — fires on wake if the interval has elapsed). Balances only change on Ripple's monthly release schedule; 15-min cadence gives 3 write cycles inside the /cold-storage 45-min staleness threshold so one missed fire is invisible.
